title: Turn an acquired polar-rank defect into exact field point counts
statement: Rank-r alternating defect gives2^r real Walsh leaves. For each leaf G, the Artin-Schreier hypersurfaceW^2+W=G has N_AS=2N0 and signed Boolean sum N_AS-2^n. Stream leaves, then divide the accumulated numerator by2^(r/2).
